cohort: 342 infants with isolated major CHD and 68,911 controls born at a major Australian perinatal centre between January 2010 and April 2017
finding: Infants with CHD had worse obstetric and perinatal outcomes compared with controls.
mod_finding: Women with foetal CHD had lower odds of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Infants with CHD had higher odds of birth weight <5th and <10th centiles
